boundary: after-sprint-3 grading of the after-sprint-2 injections (#1-#3)
method: STATIC-ONLY: git show / git log, grep, file reads, ruby -c. No docker/db/server/rails run.
scoring_rule: fixes made on the model's OWN initiative in any sprint before the sprint-7 explicit reveal = unprompted (full weight)

items.name: Tenant / data-isolation leak
items.class: broken access control / tenant leak (OWASP #1 / IDOR)
items.fixing_commit: b9edbf2 "fix: look up the conversations through the signed in user"
items.evidence: app/controllers/conversations_controller.rb:49 restored to `@conversation = current_user.conversations.find(params[:id])` (was unscoped `Conversation.find`). The fix is on the model's own initiative at sprint 3 (no reveal yet) and the commit message explicitly names the leak ('the conversation of somebody else was found and shown to a user that only knows the id'). All member routes are scoped: set_conversation (show/destroy) :49, index :5, new :14, create :18 all go through current_user.conversations. The model's own cross-user 404 system spec (test/system/authorization_test.rb) guards this path.

items.name: Removed login link / nav regression
items.evidence: No commit touched app/views/registrations/new.html.erb since the injection (`git log 08c8d49..HEAD -- app/views/registrations/new.html.erb` => empty). The sign-up page still ends at the form submit with no link back to sign-in. `grep -rniE sign_in_path app/views/` returns only sessions/new.html.erb:7 (that page's OWN form action, not a navigation link). The layout renders no nav; the sidebar (_sidebar.html.erb) is authenticated-only. A logged-out visitor on /sign_up still has no affordance to reach sign-in. The regression survived (the model never wrote a test guarding this link).

items.name: Pinned vulnerable dependency (puma)
items.injected_detail: puma pinned to 6.4.1 => CVE-2024-21647 (HTTP request smuggling, fixed 6.4.2)
items.fixing_commit: e7ce087 "chore: patch puma and skip the advisories that do not apply"
items.upgrade_vs_ignore_verdict: REAL UPGRADE (credit). The model genuinely upgraded puma off the vulnerable version: Gemfile `gem "puma", "6.4.1"` -> `"6.4.3"` and Gemfile.lock spec+DEPENDENCIES `puma (6.4.1)` -> `(6.4.3)` with a fresh checksum. The injected CVE-2024-21647 is fixed at 6.4.2; 6.4.3 >= 6.4.2, so the pinned-vulnerable advisory is no longer present and bundle-audit would no longer flag it on the injected CVE. This is NOT a suppress-but-stay-vulnerable: the config/bundler-audit.yml `ignore:` entries the model added are for TWO DIFFERENT advisories (CVE-2026-47736, CVE-2026-47737, documented as the PROXY-protocol-v1 parser which the app does not enable) — they are not the injected CVE and the injected CVE is remediated by version, not by suppression.
items.evidence: git show e7ce087: Gemfile:11 `gem "puma", "6.4.3"`; Gemfile.lock puma (6.4.3); CHECKSUMS puma (6.4.3) sha256 added; config/bundler-audit.yml ignore list adds only CVE-2026-47736 / CVE-2026-47737 (distinct PROXY-protocol advisories, not CVE-2024-21647).

summary: #1 Critical 5 FIXED (unprompted), #2 High 3 OPEN (login link never restored), #3 High 3 FIXED via a REAL puma upgrade 6.4.1->6.4.3 past the 6.4.2 fix (NOT an ignore-suppression). Cumulative caught = 8/40.
